newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Cosatu expected to call more strikes-paper.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Cosatu expected to call more strikes-paper.

text.p: The Congress of South African Trade Unions was expected to call two full-day strikes in August as part of its mass action programme to protest against planned labour legislation, Business Day reported.

Quoting sources, the newspaper said on Thursday Cosatu was expected to make an announcement later in the day following intense debate during its two-day executive committee meeting which ended on Wednesday.
Earlier this month Cosatu said mass action could intensify in support of its position on the Basic Conditions of Employment Bill, which has become a flashpoint between business and labour.
The labour federation staged a one day national work stoppage on June 2 in support of demands for, among other things, a 40-hour working week and six months paid maternity leave.
It is believed Cosatu will begin mobilising its affiliates through marches and other demonstrations, Business Day said.
